== Anagrams ==

* [[Warrant Officer M'Kae]] — Mark McKay, Mark Tuttle's radio name

== Career ==

In a 2018 interview Tuttle described SWCCG as "Tom and Rollie's game". He was recruited from ''Star Trek'' CCG community work into ''Star Wars'' playtesting around ''A New Hope''.<ref name="fantha" /> He took part in Decipher's in-house playtests from ''Star Wars'' CCG [[Premiere Limited|Premiere]] on, when they were held at the Omni hotel on the Waterside in Norfolk.<ref name="wr3" />

His radio shows followed the end of Radio Free Decipher.<ref name="rfd" /> On [[WARS Radio]] episodes 3 (9 July 2004) and 4 he interviewed [[Warren Holland]] on the origins of [[WARS TCG]].<ref name="wr3" />
